PG.rationale: P&G is a fundamentally healthy, wide-moat consumer staples franchise with strong brand portfolio, elite margins (51% gross, 24% operating), robust cash generation, and a 70-year dividend growth streak. However, the trajectory is mixed: Q3 FY2026 showed solid YoY revenue growth (+7.4%) and EPS growth (+5.8%), with volume turning positive for the first time in a year, but QoQ trends are negative (revenue -4.4%, EPS -8.4%) and the company faces a $1B after-tax headwind from oil/tariffs. Guidance is biased to the lower end of its range. Valuation at 23x P/E is near the low end of its 1-year range (21.7-26.7), suggesting fair-to-slightly-cheap pricing vs own history, but not a screaming bargain given.. The near-term catalyst (Q3 FY2026 earnings beat) volume inflection) is modestly positive but tempered by tariff/commodity headwinds and insider selling. limiting re-rating potential.
